FORM 20-F
HelioGrid PLC (Exact name of registrant as specified in its charter)
For the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025
Trading Symbol(s) HLGD Nasdaq Global Select Market
Legal Proceedings
The company is responding to an SEC subpoena and a parallel Department of Justice investigation related to revenue recognition for certain distributor contracts. A putative securities class action lawsuit was also filed in the United States District Court. Revenue was $640.0 million for 2025 compared to $612.0 million in 2024. Net income was $21.0 million for the year.
